why: Intro to the terminal, 'Find where you are' (passes: the last pwd prints the home folder). The learner walked into /Users/Shared and the last pwd prints '/Users/Shared': /Users/ plus one folder, but not their home. The earlier '/Users/tripi' is the first pwd, before the walk.

step.title: Come back home
step.instructions: Go back to your home folder (cd on its own, or cd ~), then run pwd to check where you are. Your home folder is /Users/ followed by your user name.

targets.caption: Print the folder you are in

Terminal: Applications	System		Users		Volumes		bin		usr
